body: A Python library with labeled data structures and tools for manipulating and analyzing data.
plain_description: **Analyze and organize business data with Python.** Work with labeled data, combine and reshape datasets, and load information from files and databases.
technical_description: pandas is a Python package for data analysis and manipulation. It provides labeled data structures, missing-data handling, alignment, grouping, merging, joining, reshaping, indexing, and time-series features. It includes tools for reading CSV, Excel, and database data and for storing data in HDF5.
title: pandas
